# f5xc_dns_lb_health_check (Resource)

DnsLbHealthCheck resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "f5xc_dns_lb_health_check" "example" {
  name      = "example_dns_lb_health_check"
  namespace = "example_namespace"
  health_check_choice = {
    tcp_hex_health_check = {
      tcp_hex_health_check = "example_tcp_hex_health_check"
    }
  }
}
```
